date_policy: Catalogued object/design dates remain seller date candidates; auction dates are not awards dates.
polity_policy: Treat 1910-era local Hungarian objects as Kingdom-era/local context rather than an Austro-Hungarian state award. Modern Hungary entries remain assigned to their observed republic/People's Republic period candidates; no successor-state conflation.
